subject: pathology
title: Non neoplastic CNS disease: stroke, MS, meningitis and prions

steps.tx: **Ischaemic stroke** (thrombotic atherosclerosis, embolic AF, lacunar lipohyalinosis) syndromes localise: **MCA** (contralateral face arm weakness with aphasia or neglect), ACA (leg), PCA (visual), basilar (locked in), lacunar (pure motor or sensory). Management is **IV alteplase within 4.5 hours** (no bleed on CT, BP controlled) with **thrombectomy to 24 hours** in large vessel occlusion, then aspirin, statin, AF anticoagulation delayed, decompressive hemicraniectomy in malignant oedema. Stroke mimics (hypoglycaemia, Todd, conversion) glucose first.
steps.say: Face arm aphasia is MCA: CT rules bleed, alteplase in 4.5 hours, thrombectomy to 24. Glucose every mimic first.

steps.tx: **Subarachnoid haemorrhage** (**berry aneurysms** at bifurcations: ACom, PCom with third nerve palsy, MCA; autosomal dominant PKD, smoking) strikes as **thunderclap headache** with vomiting and neck stiffness; noncontrast CT with **LP xanthochromia** (if CT negative) confirms, CTA finds. Complications (rebleed, **vasospasm** days 4 to 14 with **nimodipine**, hydrocephalus, SIADH or cerebral salt wasting) are coiled or clipped urgently; grading (Hunt Hess, Fisher) prognosticates. Sentinel leaks warn.
steps.say: Thunderclap worst headache is SAH: CT, xanthochromia if clean, nimodipine for vasospasm. PCom blows the third nerve.

steps.tx: **Multiple sclerosis** (autoimmune demyelination, young women, temperate latitudes, EBV linked, **periventricular Dawson fingers**, juxtacortical and infratentorial plaques) relapses with **internuclear ophthalmoplegia** (MLF, adduction lag with nystagmus), optic neuritis, Lhermitte and Uhthoff heat worsening; **oligoclonal bands** with raised IgG index confirm dissemination in time and space on MRI. Relapses get pulsed steroids with plasma exchange refractory; **disease modifiers** (interferon, natalizumab with **PML** risk, ocrelizumab, fingolimod) slow. **ADEM** (postviral children, monophasic, encephalopathy) differs.
steps.say: Heat worsened internuclear lag with Dawson fingers is MS: bands confirm, steroids pulse. PML haunts natalizumab.

steps.tx: **Meningitis** sorts by CSF: bacterial (neutrophils, low glucose, high protein, ceftriaxone plus vancomycin with dexamethasone before antibiotics), viral (lymphocytes, normal glucose, support), **TB** (basal exudates with cranial nerve palsies, low glucose with high protein, ATT with steroids). **Brain abscess** (otitis or cyanotic heart, ring enhancement with toxoplasma in AIDS treated empirically, bacterial aspirated) and **CJD prion** (rapid dementia with myoclonus, periodic sharp complexes, 14-3-3, no cure, precautions) complete emergencies; **normal pressure hydrocephalus** (**wet, wobbly, wacky** triad, tap test improving, shunt) reverses dementia.
steps.say: Neck stiffness photophobia: tap CSF, dexamethasone then antibiotics. Wet wobbly wacky improving on tap is NPH: shunt.
